scripts.start:full: node -e "const os=require('os'); const nets=os.networkInterfaces(); const ip = Object.keys(nets).filter(n => !n.toLowerCase().includes('docker') && !n.toLowerCase().includes('vethernet') && !n.toLowerCase().includes('wsl') && !n.toLowerCase().includes('virtual')).map(n => nets[n].find(i => i.family==='IPv4' && !i.internal)).filter(Boolean).map(i => i.address).sort((a,b) => a.startsWith('192')?-1:1)[0] || 'localhost'; console.log('✅ Real Network IP:', ip); require('child_process').execSync('docker-compose up --build -d', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, DETECTED_IP: ip } }); console.log('📱 Opening QR Code...'); require('child_process').execSync('docker logs -f react_client_container', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
